about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Third Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, graciously absolve us from all guilt and danger, whom Thou grantest to partake of so great a mystery. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
